mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.title, p.category, p.author_id, p.author_name, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM post_posts p WHERE p.status = 'published'
AND (p.title ILIKE '%' || #{query.keyword} || '%' OR p.content ILIKE '%' || #{query.keyword} || '%')
AND p.category = #{query.category}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_post_tags t WHERE t.post_id = p.id AND t.tag_name = #{query.tag} )
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE post_posts SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{postId} AND status = 'published'
UPDATE post_posts SET comment_count = comment_count + 1, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{postId} AND status = 'published'
